title: I've been working on my trailer. What do you think?
author: LatentBlade
selftext: All visual assets were made using Nano Banana and Omni. I think the video to sheets is still a pain. There's a lot of video thrown away and I have to massage the timing of action sequences quite a bit. I did all that post processing in jupyter notebooks. Music is produced by DR42 (me). I'd like to get to the point where I'm just making/balancing cards and writing music.

comments.author: gamedevjp
comments.body: The music doesn't seem fit for the trailer. It's a little too hype and doesn't allow a lot of room to breath. Idk why but I found it hard to read your cards with the music LOL

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: I'll take that as a win as a producer. I was trying to be my own hype man
